purpose: Teach: 伊達/沸い/問答/贈ら/リスナー/河原/ペダル/バク

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、お客さん、本気で、絶対、伊達メガネ、絶対、結構、本気で、絶対、かけてはるな
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's really wearing fake glasses, isn't he? Seriously.
lines.style: Warm, animated Kansai cadence. Leans in with genuine delight. Quick pace, rolling r-sounds with affection. Like he's spotted something funny and can't wait to share it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新メニューで、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、沸いてくださいそう、葵で、本気で、絶対、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: Yes. With the new menu, I think customers are really getting excited about it. I'm having so much fun.
lines.style: Genuine brightness without trying too hard. Soft, conversational pace. A slight lift at the end — she means it but isn't performing. Natural and grounded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、お客さんが、本気で、絶対、問答、絶対、無用で、絶対、葵を、絶対、愛してくれてはるって、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Aoi, it's real — customers genuinely love you without question. I'm really grateful for that.
lines.style: Sincere, almost serious underneath the Kansai warmth. Slower than before. Steady eye-contact level delivery. He means every word and isn't hiding behind the accent.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お客様から、本気で、絶対、お花、絶対、贈られた、絶対、嬉しい瞬間、葵で、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When customers bring me flowers, those moments really touch me. I'm so thankful.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. A small pause before speaking. Soft voice like she's admitting something private. Tender but not fragile. Means it completely.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、本気で、絶対、ラジオのリスナー、絶対、お客様、絶対、増やしていく、絶対、企画、本気で、絶対、進めよか
lines.en: Aoi, let's keep growing the radio listener base and the customer community. I want to push this forward.
lines.style: Energized, forward-leaning. Kansai warmth with practical urgency underneath. Quick rhythm on the plans. Optimistic and inclusive — this is a we, not an I.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。河原で、本気で、絶対、ピクニック、絶対、お客様、絶対、企画、絶対、葵で、お招きできたら、嬉しいですね
lines.en: Yes. If we could invite customers for a picnic by the riverside as part of the plan, I'd love that.
lines.style: Eager but thoughtful. A small rise in pitch on the invitation idea. Warm, inclusive tone. She's genuinely imagining it — soft and hopeful without being tentative.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、本気で、絶対、自転車のペダル、絶対、漕いで、配達、絶対、本気で、絶対、続けてまいります
lines.en: Aoi, I'll keep pedaling on those deliveries. I'm committed to this.
lines.style: Grounded, determined. Steady Kansai accent. Direct and practical but full of quiet resolve. Like a promise made without fanfare — just stating what will be.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。動物園、本気で、絶対、バクの絵を、絶対、お子様向け、メニュー、本気で、絶対、デザイン、絶対、加えませんか
lines.en: Yes. What if we designed a tapir illustration for a kids' menu? I think that would be lovely.
lines.style: Warm, creative spark. Soft invitation in the tone — offering an idea not pushing it. Gentle lift at the end. Close and collaborative. Like she's trusted him enough to dream out loud.
